0022600227.text: Philadelphia, 9-3 and 2nd in the East, hosts Toronto, 5-5 and 6th in the East, and the 76ers come in on a one-game losing streak after going 7-3 over their last ten. The teams have not met yet this season, and they split their 2025-26 series 2-2, with Philadelphia winning the most recent meeting 115-102 in Toronto on January 12, 2026. Philadelphia is without Adem Bona (out, back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery), and Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), and Joel Embiid (foot) and LeBron James (back) are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions. Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (out, knee inflammation), Nate Bittle (out, foot fracture), Scottie Barnes (out, groin soreness), and Trayce Jackson-Davis (out, illness).
